## Motivation

Disaggregated diffusion moves tensors between the encoder, denoiser and decoder roles through a transfer engine, and the only engine was Mooncake. A host without Mooncake (for example Intel XPU, where Mooncake is not available) could not run disaggregation at all.

`--disagg-transfer-backend` already accepts `auto`, `mock` and `mooncake` (#26119), but `create_transfer_engine` never read the flag and no mock engine existed. Passing `mock` was accepted and then ignored.

`_check_mooncake()` also could not detect a missing install. It imported sglang's Mooncake wrapper module, which imports `mooncake.engine` lazily inside `MooncakeTransferEngine`, so the check passed whenever sglang itself imported.

## Modifications

- `runtime/disaggregation/transport/engine.py`
  - Add `MockTransferEngine`, a transfer engine that copies over TCP between registered host-memory buffers, with no RDMA. Each transfer is sent as a `(dst_addr, length)` header plus payload. The receiver checks that the write fits inside its registered buffer, writes it there, and sends back a 1-byte ack. A batch reuses one connection. `deregister_buffer` stops the accept loop and joins in-flight connection threads before clearing the buffer, so no write lands after teardown.
  - `create_transfer_engine` now takes `backend`:
    - `mooncake` behaves as before and raises if Mooncake is not installed.
    - `mock` returns the mock engine.
    - `auto` (the default) uses Mooncake when it imports; otherwise it logs a warning and uses the mock engine.
  - `_check_mooncake` imports `mooncake.engine` directly.
- `runtime/disaggregation/scheduler_mixin.py`: pass `disagg_transfer_backend` to the factory. The buffer-placement logic is unchanged. The mock engine reports `supports_gpu_direct=False`, so its buffer stays in pinned CPU memory, and Mooncake still gets a device buffer.
- `runtime/server_args`: accept `xpu` for `--disagg-role-device`, next to `cuda`. Like `cuda`, the value is parsed but not read anywhere today (its reader was removed in #43064); this only keeps the choices consistent across platforms.
- `test/single_test_file/test_disagg_server.py`: `_require_gpus` counts XPU devices when CUDA is not available, so the end-to-end test can run on XPU.
- Add `test/unit/test_disagg_mock_transfer_engine.py`.

**Behavior change:** with the default `auto`, a host without Mooncake now starts on the mock engine with a warning instead of failing at startup. Hosts with Mooncake installed are unchanged. To keep failing at startup, pass `--disagg-transfer-backend mooncake`.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no model forward or kernel changes. The unit tests check that the received bytes match the sent bytes exactly.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

The Mooncake path is unchanged. The mock engine copies through host memory over TCP; it exists for correctness and for platforms without RDMA, not for speed.

## Testing

On an Intel XPU host (torch 2.14 + XPU):

- `pytest python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_disagg_mock_transfer_engine.py`: 5 passed. Covers:
  - bytes delivered at the right offsets
  - out-of-bounds write rejected
  - batch delivered over one connection
  - `auto` falls back to mock without Mooncake
  - `auto` prefers Mooncake when it imports
- `pytest python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_server_args.py -k disagg`: 7 passed.
- Manual checks:
  - A zero-length transfer succeeds.
  - A header split across two sends is reassembled correctly.
  - A peer that closes without acking makes the call return -1 instead of hanging.
- End-to-end: `test_disagg_server.py` <RESULT>

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

         )
 
 
+def _memoryview_from_ptr(ptr: int, length: int) -> memoryview:
+    return memoryview((ctypes.c_ubyte * length).from_address(ptr))
+
+
+def _recv_into_exact(conn: socket.socket, view: memoryview) -> None:
+    offset = 0
+    remaining = len(view)
+    while remaining > 0:
+        n = conn.recv_into(view[offset:], remaining)
+        if n == 0:
+            raise ConnectionError(
+                "MockTransferEngine: peer closed before sending all data"
+            )
+        offset += n
+        remaining -= n
+
+
+class MockTransferEngine(BaseTransferEngine):
+    """Non-RDMA fallback engine: copies between host-memory buffers over TCP."""
+
+    _HEADER = struct.Struct("!QQ")
+
+    def __init__(self, hostname: str = "127.0.0.1"):
+        self._lock = threading.Lock()
+        self._local_ptr = 0
+        self._local_len = 0
+
+        self._server = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
+        self._server.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
+        self._server.bind((hostname, 0))
+        self._server.listen(16)
+        self._server.settimeout(0.5)
+        bound_port = self._server.getsockname()[1]
+        self._session_id = f"{hostname}:{bound_port}"
+
+        self._stop = threading.Event()
+        self._conn_threads: list[threading.Thread] = []
+        self._accept_thread = threading.Thread(
+            target=self._accept_loop, daemon=True, name="mock-transfer-engine-accept"
+        )
+        self._accept_thread.start()
+        logger.info("MockTransferEngine initialized: session_id=%s", self._session_id)
+
+    @property
+    def session_id(self) -> str:
+        return self._session_id
+
+    def register_buffer(self, ptr: int, length: int) -> None:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._local_ptr = ptr
+            self._local_len = length
+
+    def deregister_buffer(self, ptr: int) -> None:
+        self._stop.set()
+        self._accept_thread.join()
+        self._server.close()
+        with self._lock:
+            conn_threads = list(self._conn_threads)
+        for conn_thread in conn_threads:
+            conn_thread.join(timeout=5)
+            if conn_thread.is_alive():
+                logger.warning(
+                    "MockTransferEngine: a connection thread outlived "
+                    "deregister_buffer; a write may still land after teardown"
+                )
+        with self._lock:
+            self._local_ptr = 0
+            self._local_len = 0
+
+    def _accept_loop(self) -> None:
+        while not self._stop.is_set():
+            try:
+                conn, _ = self._server.accept()
+            except socket.timeout:
+                continue
+            except OSError:
+                return
+            conn_thread = threading.Thread(
+                target=self._serve_conn, args=(conn,), daemon=True
+            )
+            with self._lock:
+                self._conn_threads = [t for t in self._conn_threads if t.is_alive()]
+                self._conn_threads.append(conn_thread)
+            conn_thread.start()
+
+    def _serve_conn(self, conn: socket.socket) -> None:
+        header = bytearray(self._HEADER.size)
+        try:
+            while True:
+                n = conn.recv_into(header)
+                if n == 0:
+                    return
+                _recv_into_exact(conn, memoryview(header)[n:])
+                dst_addr, length = self._HEADER.unpack(header)
+                with self._lock:
+                    ptr, size = self._local_ptr, self._local_len
+                if dst_addr < ptr or dst_addr + length > ptr + size:
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"dst_addr {dst_addr}+{length} outside registered buffer "
+                        f"[{ptr}, {ptr + size})"
+                    )
+                _recv_into_exact(conn, _memoryview_from_ptr(dst_addr, length))
+                conn.sendall(b"\x01")
+        except Exception:
+            logger.exception("MockTransferEngine: failed to serve incoming transfer")
+        finally:
+            conn.close()
+
+    def transfer_sync(
+        self, dst_session_id: str, src_addr: int, dst_addr: int, length: int
+    ) -> int:
+        return self.batch_transfer_sync(
+            dst_session_id, [src_addr], [dst_addr], [length]
+        )
+
+    def batch_transfer_sync(
+        self,
+        dst_session_id: str,
+        src_addrs: list[int],
+        dst_addrs: list[int],
+        lengths: list[int],
+    ) -> int:
+        try:
+            host, port_str = dst_session_id.rsplit(":", 1)
+            with socket.create_connection((host, int(port_str))) as conn:
+                for src_addr, dst_addr, length in zip(src_addrs, dst_addrs, lengths):
+                    conn.sendall(self._HEADER.pack(dst_addr, length))
+                    conn.sendall(_memoryview_from_ptr(src_addr, length))
+                    if conn.recv(1) != b"\x01":
+                        raise ValueError("peer did not ack the transfer")
+            return 0
+        except Exception:
+            logger.exception(
+                "MockTransferEngine: batch_transfer_sync to %s failed", dst_session_id
+            )
+            return -1
+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Unit tests for the non-RDMA MockTransferEngine fallback."""
+
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.disaggregation.transport import (
+    engine as engine_module,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.disaggregation.transport.engine import (
+    MockTransferEngine,
+    MooncakeDiffusionEngine,
+    create_transfer_engine,
+)
+
+
+class TestMockTransferEngine(unittest.TestCase):
+    def _registered_engine(self, size: int):
+        pool = torch.zeros(size, dtype=torch.uint8)
+        engine = MockTransferEngine(hostname="127.0.0.1")
+        self.addCleanup(engine.deregister_buffer, pool.data_ptr())
+        engine.register_buffer(pool.data_ptr(), pool.numel())
+        return engine, pool
+
+    def test_round_trip_delivers_bytes_at_matching_offset(self):
+        sender, sender_pool = self._registered_engine(4096)
+        receiver, receiver_pool = self._registered_engine(4096)
+
+        payload = torch.arange(256, dtype=torch.uint8)
+        src_offset, dst_offset = 128, 512
+        sender_pool[src_offset : src_offset + len(payload)] = payload
+
+        ret = sender.transfer_sync(
+            receiver.session_id,
+            sender_pool.data_ptr() + src_offset,
+            receiver_pool.data_ptr() + dst_offset,
+            len(payload),
+        )
+
+        self.assertEqual(ret, 0)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            receiver_pool[dst_offset : dst_offset + len(payload)], payload
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(torch.all(receiver_pool[:dst_offset] == 0))
+        self.assertTrue(torch.all(receiver_pool[dst_offset + len(payload) :] == 0))
+
+    def test_write_outside_registered_buffer_is_rejected(self):
+        sender, sender_pool = self._registered_engine(64)
+        receiver, receiver_pool = self._registered_engine(64)
+
+        ret = sender.transfer_sync(
+            receiver.session_id,
+            sender_pool.data_ptr(),
+            receiver_pool.data_ptr() + receiver_pool.numel(),  # one past the end
+            16,
+        )
+
+        self.assertNotEqual(ret, 0)
+
+    def test_batch_delivers_all_tensors_over_one_connection(self):
+        sender, sender_pool = self._registered_engine(4096)
+        receiver, receiver_pool = self._registered_engine(4096)
+
+        payloads = [
+            torch.arange(i * 16, (i + 1) * 16, dtype=torch.uint8) for i in range(4)
+        ]
+        src_offsets = [0, 64, 128, 192]
+        dst_offsets = [512, 768, 1024, 1280]
+        for payload, src_offset in zip(payloads, src_offsets):
+            sender_pool[src_offset : src_offset + len(payload)] = payload
+
+        ret = sender.batch_transfer_sync(
+            receiver.session_id,
+            [sender_pool.data_ptr() + o for o in src_offsets],
+            [receiver_pool.data_ptr() + o for o in dst_offsets],
+            [len(p) for p in payloads],
+        )
+
+        self.assertEqual(ret, 0)
+        for payload, dst_offset in zip(payloads, dst_offsets):
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                receiver_pool[dst_offset : dst_offset + len(payload)], payload
+            )
+
+    def test_auto_backend_falls_back_to_mock_without_mooncake(self):
+        with patch.object(engine_module, "_check_mooncake", return_value=False):
+            engine = create_transfer_engine(hostname="127.0.0.1", backend="auto")
+        self.addCleanup(engine.deregister_buffer, 0)
+        self.assertIsInstance(engine, MockTransferEngine)
+        self.assertFalse(engine.supports_gpu_direct)
+
+    def test_auto_backend_prefers_mooncake_once_it_imports(self):
+        with (
+            patch.object(engine_module, "_check_mooncake", return_value=True),
+            patch.object(MooncakeDiffusionEngine, "__init__", return_value=None),
+        ):
+            engine = create_transfer_engine(hostname="127.0.0.1", backend="auto")
+        self.assertIsInstance(engine, MooncakeDiffusionEngine)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
